propositions: The import-linter job in _optionality.yml duplicates test coverage already provided by the default test matrix and consumes a scarce concurrent job slot against GitHub's 20-slot cap.

Deleting the import-linter job creates an invisible guard gap: the two test files will still run only because they carry no pytest markers, with no mechanism to catch future edits that add markers or move the files.
A durable checked-in test must assert that tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py and tests/unit/test_optional.py are collected by the default suite selection and yield exactly 9 items.

The guard test must fail if any marker excluding either file from the default selection (file-level pytestmark, decorator, or conftest-applied) is added, catching the gap at commit time rather than in production.
